title: feat(approvals): surface decisionOutputs keys on the request row (#3447 P2 UI enablement)
body:
## What

Surfaces the approval node's author-declared `decisionOutputs` keys on the request read as `ApprovalRequestRow.decision_outputs` — the data prerequisite for the decision dialog to render one input per key and POST `outputs` with approve/reject (objectui follow-up in objectstack-ai/objectui).

The set varies per request (each node declares its own), so it rides the row instead of `sys_approval_request`'s static action `params` — a static params array cannot enumerate a per-request field set.

Small and additive: `rowFromRequest` reads `decisionOutputs` off the existing config snapshot; contracts type + test. Follow-up to #3447 P2 (#3532).
